# NeuronX

> NeuronX is an AI consulting and engineering partner. We help enterprises and startups turn AI into measurable business outcomes — from strategy to production AI systems.

- [Industries](/industries): Industries we serve and domain expertise.
- [Case Studies](/case-studies): Customer outcomes from production AI deployments.
- [Insights](/insights): Articles on applied AI, architecture, and operations.
- [Security](/security): SOC 2, SSO/SAML, VPC and on-prem deployment options.

## Flagship Solutions

- [AI Voice Agents](/solutions/ai-voice-agents): Inbound and outbound voice agents handling calls 24/7.
- [Predictive Pricing Engine](/solutions/predictive-pricing-engine): Forecasting and dynamic pricing models on your data.
- [Custom GPT & Copilots](/solutions/custom-gpt-copilots): Domain-trained copilots for sales, support, ops.
- [Internal Search AI](/solutions/internal-search-ai): Hybrid semantic search across every doc, ticket, and channel.
- [AI Workflow Automation](/solutions/ai-workflow-automation): Multi-step agents that take action across your stack.
- [Proposal & Document AI](/solutions/proposal-document-ai): Generate proposals, reports, and contracts from your templates.
